goalZh: 读懂一则查房通知:时间、要做的准备和不许有的东西
canDoZh: 能看懂查房通知:什么时间、要做哪些准备、哪些东西不允许

newItems.noteZh: 很多美国宿舍不许用电暖器,怕着火;heater 的 t 读闪音。
be allowed:Pets aren't allowed. 不许养宠物;读音和 aloud(大声地)一样。
tch 读 /tʃ/;宿舍每层的公共厨房常叫 the kitchen 或 the shared kitchen。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Room Inspection: Friday, 10 a.m. to 4 p.m.
lines.zh: (宿舍办公室贴在每层楼的通知)查房:周五上午 10 点到下午 4 点

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: We knock first, and then we come in.
lines.zh: 我们会先敲门,再进房间。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Clean the fridge. No old food, please!
lines.zh: 清理冰箱,别留旧的食物!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Clean the bathroom, and vacuum the room.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Don't put boxes in front of your door.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Not allowed in rooms: pets, candles, and space heaters
lines.zh: 房间里不允许有:宠物、蜡烛、电暖器

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: No cooking in your room. Please cook in the kitchen.
lines.zh: 不能在房间里做饭,请去厨房做。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Is something broken? Please tell us.
lines.zh: 有东西坏了?请告诉我们。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 弄坏的东西要照价赔偿。

options: 周五上午 10 点到下午 4 点
questions.explainZh: Room Inspection: Friday, 10 a.m. to 4 p.m.——周五上午 10 点到下午 4 点。

questions.prompt: 下面哪样东西不能放在宿舍房间里?
questions.explainZh: Not allowed in rooms: pets, candles, and space heaters——宠物、蜡烛、电暖器都不允许;冰箱要清理干净。
Don't put boxes in front of your door.——门口不要堆箱子(挡路,也不安全)。

questions.prompt: 房间里的东西坏了,应该怎么办?
questions.explainZh: Is something broken? Please tell us.——告诉宿舍办公室;自己弄坏的要赔(You pay for broken things.)。

grammar.titleZh: 告示的写法:祈使句、No + 名词、Not allowed
grammar.bodyZh: 告示、通知常用很短的句子:要做的事用祈使句(Take out the trash. Clean the fridge.);不许做的事用 Don't… 或 No + 名词 / 动词-ing(No cooking in your room.);列出不许有的东西用 Not allowed: …。allowed 是"被允许的",在句子里前面要有 be:Pets aren't allowed.(不许养宠物)。读告示先找时间(Friday, 10 a.m. to 4 p.m.),再找要做的事和不许做的事。

examples.text: Pets and space heaters aren't allowed.
examples.zh: 不允许养宠物、用电暖器。

examples.text: Don't put boxes in front of your door.
